extracted.name: Simple Lemon Herb Chicken
extracted.description: This lemon herb chicken is a quick and easy main dish of juicy chicken breasts flavored with lemon, oregano, and parsley—ready in just 15 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 2 (5 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instruction_lines: Place chicken in a bowl; pour 1/2 of the lemon juice over chicken and season with salt.

Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium-low heat. Place chicken into hot oil. Add remaining lemon juice and oregano; season with black pepper. Cook chicken until golden brown and the juices run clear, 5 to 10 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Garnish chicken with parsley to serve.
